sloka: तथा त्वम् सम्परिष्वज्य रौद्रया अतिनृशंसया ।काल रात्र्या मया आच्चिद्य हृतः कमल लोचन ।। ६-३२-१५।।
transliteration: tathā tvam sampariṣvajya raudrayā atinṛśaṁsayā ।kāla rātryā mayā āccidya hṛtaḥ kamala locana ।। 6-32-15।।

translations.english: "O lotuseyed Rama! After you have lost contact with me, the most horrible cruel night has killed you cutting you off from me."
